system.longDesc:
Requirement: Digital Arcana (Novice)

Cost: 3 PP

Time: 1 minute

Target Number: 9

Test: None

You place an invisible arcane “tag” on an object, which remains until you choose to dismiss it as a free action. Once an object is tagged, you can track it with a GPS-enabled device and another casting of this spell (TN 11). The GPS device picks up the tag’s location as if it were an electronic transmitter.
